body:
## Problem and resulting behavior

A forged caller claim must not spend another account's authorization. A native commit must also retain its result when later authentication competition, cancellation or transport prevents the signed ACK.

This continuation integrates the reviewed r16 authentication boundary and r17 response reservation into the existing integration candidate. Responses reserve original authentication principal and slots after authenticated dequeue and before decode/native dispatch. Actual signing consumes that reservation once, and actual worker settlement controls release. Final listener, History and continuous owners retain classical/PQ pending or unknown obligations.

## Concurrent source preserved

The candidate preserves both the original throughput source and the subsequent d26e047dedfcdb17a1ac2c47cc26e6f1185f6b89 continuation: bounded exact mathematical-refusal reuse, same-writer Legacy readback, original failure evidence and the existing integration-push source resolver. It moves the fallible default cache allocation before first Node domain binding. Resource revision r17 and its exact vectors remain unchanged.

The TCP tests now synchronize through existing owner-published atomic closure instead of polling diagnostic locks. The strict actual work-phase EOF, complete diagnostic and outstanding-worker budget assertions remain. No deadline, worker count or Host allowance is increased.

## Exact candidate and current evidence

Head: 68c664332e340591e629c4db0f611f11e33135f1
Tree: e9abf07334b97a1d9862ccc3f49350956c2decf1

Complete tracked-source byte verification passed for 11,186 entries / 1,033,852,663 bytes. Pinned formatting, distributed source inventory, all 26 workflow literal guards and the 583-blob PQ source guard passed before freezing. PQ remains HOLD_NO_GO with no cryptographic acceptance.

[Retained preliminary observations](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/tree/68c664332e340591e629c4db0f611f11e33135f1/evidence/pon-w1-response-reservation-r17-20261107) bind the earlier 33fdb7a27 candidate: 42 selected native tests passed, one strict cancellation observation test failed, and two local source-control suites reached the driver's 180-second limit. Raw results are preserved; the corrected combined source does not inherit a PASS from those observations.

Final combined-source component tests, strict workspace Clippy, locked Cargo graphs, full negative/source controls and original hosted qualification are pending/running and will be reported with their exact source identities.

## Original acceptance and remaining boundaries

Preserve 0.25 CPU, 2 GiB, zero swap, 256 PIDs and the original 4-second / 16-hostile gate. Preserve three complete 0/24/24 campaigns, full 4,105-block History, capacity/churn and independent WAN as separate requirements. Component tests do not substitute for them.

This PR's prospective-merge lane binds its actual integration base. The new push resolver applies only to the existing integration branch and explicitly binds a separately observed main/base; it is not a GitHub PR merge.

A reservation does not guarantee ACK delivery after deadline, cancellation, provider/accounting failure, network loss or an actual PQ lifetime overrun. Pending slots can delay later requests. Exact refusal caching does not solve distinct false-trace cost asymmetry. No anonymous fairness, accepted-work cost floor, economic break-even, production activation, force push or main merge is claimed.
